themes_detail.label: Sanitation Crisis: Missed Pickups
themes_detail.summary: Missed Collection complaints spiked to 13 this week 2 weeks ago versus a baseline of 1.5 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 767% increase (z-score: 7.27)—signaling a severe waste management failure affecting the district.
evidence: 13 Missed Collection complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (767% spike, z-score: 7.27)
Statistically significant deviation indicates systematic service failure, not isolated incidents
Brownsville/Ocean Hill residents experiencing visible trash accumulation on streets and sidewalks
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about staffing shortages or operational issues affecting this district specifically
Document resident experiences: blocked storefronts, health hazards, pest attraction from uncollected waste
Track whether spike correlates with specific sanitation routes, contractual changes, or labor disruptions

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retail Surge
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis Retailer complaints jumped to 6 last week versus a baseline of 1.8 per week over 8 weeks—a 243% increase (z-score: 3.54)—suggesting rapid, potentially unregulated retail expansion in the district.
evidence: 6 Cannabis Retailer complaints last week vs. 1.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (243% spike, z-score: 3.54)
Complaints likely reflect unlicensed operations or non-compliance with local regulations
Retail expansion outpacing city licensing capacity in this economically vulnerable district
reporting_angles: Map illicit vs. licensed cannabis retailers in Brownsville; identify unlicensed storefronts via 311 complaint addresses
Interview community members about concerns: public consumption, youth access, neighborhood safety
Examine OCME licensing records to determine how many complaints reference non-compliant businesses

themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Degradation
themes_detail.summary: Missing Street Signs complaints spiked to 3 last week versus 0.6 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 380% increase (z-score: 4.91)—suggesting rapid deterioration of wayfinding infrastructure across the district.
evidence: 3 Missing Street Sign complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (380% spike, z-score: 4.91)
Coupled with Overgrown Tree/Branches spike (4 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.6 avg, 540% increase) suggests broader street maintenance backlog
Missing signs create navigation hazards and signal neighborhood disinvestment
reporting_angles: Survey street conditions in Brownsville: document missing or damaged signs via photo essay
Contact NYDOT about maintenance schedules and why this district is underserved
Connect to broader city budget cuts or contractor underperformance in this district

themes_detail.label: Food Safety Inspection Spike
themes_detail.summary: Food Establishment complaints surged to 7 two weeks ago versus 0.9 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 700% spike (z-score: 5.82)—indicating either a cluster of violations or newly detected health/safety infractions at local restaurants/food retailers.
evidence: 7 Food Establishment complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike, z-score: 5.82)
Complaints may reflect pest infestations, temperature control failures, or unsanitary practices
Cluster timing suggests either a source (e.g., supplier issue, pest outbreak) or enforcement action
reporting_angles: Cross-reference 311 complaint addresses with DOHMH inspection records; identify specific establishments flagged
Interview Health Department about whether recent complaints triggered inspections and what violations were found
Report on food safety conditions in Brownsville: consumer risk, repeat violators, enforcement patterns

themes_detail.label: Safety Complaints Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Safety complaints doubled to 12 two weeks ago versus 5.4 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 123% increase (z-score: 3.55)—reflecting residents' heightened concerns about public safety in the district.
evidence: 12 Safety complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 5.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (123% spike, z-score: 3.55)
Complaint types under 'Safety' category likely include street crime, gang activity, or emergency service concerns
Spike suggests either genuine escalation or heightened resident reporting following a specific incident
reporting_angles: Analyze NYPD crime data for Brownsville: compare violent crime, robbery, and assault trends to 311 spike timing
Interview residents and community leaders about specific safety incidents that prompted complaints
Investigate whether increased 311 reporting correlates with police presence, community organizing, or a crime event
